steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the single line item required by the scenario.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Schedule the event before publishing.
Add one QA vendor to both stages.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's Technical response as the vendor.
Fill the available technical response fields so the response can be submitted.
Accept the required NDA term on the Technical response.
Submit the technical response after accepting the NDA.
Verify that the vendor's technical response was accepted/submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing round without accepting its payment term.
Attempt the RFQ bid and verify Procol blocks it while "Payment within 45 days" remains unaccepted.
